# heraut version

Print version information.

Read versions without changing anything: next is the tag a release would create, current is the
latest released tag. sprint bump advances the sprint counter of CalVer formats that use SPRINT.

## Usage

```text
heraut version [command]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut version next
heraut version current --bare
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |

## Subcommands

- [heraut version current](heraut_version_current.md): Print the latest released tag
- [heraut version next](heraut_version_next.md): Compute and print the next version without side effects
